summary:
Constellation Energy EPS 超預期 5.3%、營收年增高達 63.8%，盤後大漲 0.63%，22 倍本益比低估，AI 資料中心核電需求爆發，為本批次最強能源股。
• EPS $2.74 超越預估 $2.60，驚喜幅度 +5.3%，核電長期供電協議貢獻穩定獲利基礎。
• 單季營收 $111.2 億美元，年增幅高達 63.8%，AI 資料中心電力需求簽訂長期購電協議（PPA）帶動爆炸性成長。
• 本益比 22.0 倍，市值 $906 億美元，在 AI/清潔能源熱潮下估值相對偏低，具重評價空間。
• 盤後股價上漲 0.63%，反映市場對核電長期需求前景持正向態度。
• 63.8% 的年增率源於大量 AI 相關電力需求合約，顯示 Constellation 在核電 AI 賦能敘事中佔據核心位置。
ai_view:
Constellation Energy 是本批次中「AI 賦能清潔能源」敘事最純粹的受益標的——63.8% 年增率在非科技股中幾乎無出其右，核心驅動力是 AI 超大規模資料中心對穩定 24/7 清潔電力的強勁需求，而核電是目前唯一能大規模兌現此需求的電源。22 倍本益比相較 63.8% 年增率顯示出顯著折價，可能反映市場對核電長期合約可持續性的審慎態度，但同時也意味著若 AI 電力需求持續，當前估值存在相當大的重評價空間。短期而言，基本面正向動能明確；中期而言，隨著更多 AI 超大規模客戶（微軟、谷歌、AWS）的 PPA 合約確認，Constellation 的收入能見度將持續提升。需追蹤指標：新增 PPA 合約規模與期限、核電廠容量因子（capacity factor）維持水準、美國核能監管政策進展（SMR 授權、廠齡延伸申請）、以及大型科技客戶電力需求擴張計畫。在 AI 基礎設施電力需求長期成長的趨勢下，Constellation 是本批次中最具中長期上行潛力的非科技標的。

需留意：63.8% 年增率高度依賴 AI 相關電力合約，若 AI 資料中心建設放緩或客戶合約重新談判，成長率將大幅回落。；核電廠運營面臨監管、核廢料處理與維護成本的長期結構性風險，任何安全事故都將引發重大估值衝擊。；能源監管政策變動（電力市場設計、補貼政策）可能影響 PPA 定價能力，需密切追蹤美國能源政策環境。

summary_en:
Constellation Energy beat EPS by 5.3% with 63.8% YoY revenue growth; a +0.63% post-earnings gain and 22x P/E appear undervalued relative to AI-driven nuclear power demand surge.
• EPS of $2.74 beat the $2.60 estimate by 5.3%, supported by stable nuclear power supply agreements.
• Revenue of $11.12B grew 63.8% YoY—an extraordinary top-line surge driven by AI data center power purchase agreements (PPAs).
• P/E of 22.0x on a $90.6B market cap appears relatively low given the AI-driven nuclear demand narrative, suggesting re-rating potential.
• Post-earnings stock gained +0.63%, reflecting positive sentiment toward long-term nuclear power demand.
• 63.8% YoY revenue growth reflects large AI-related power contracts; Constellation is a central name in the nuclear power/AI enabling theme.

ai_view_en:
Constellation Energy is the purest 'AI-enabling clean energy' beneficiary in this batch—63.8% YoY revenue growth is extraordinary for a non-tech company, driven by hyperscaler demand for 24/7 reliable clean power that only nuclear can deliver at scale. A 22x P/E against 63.8% growth implies a significant valuation discount, possibly reflecting market caution about long-term contract sustainability, but simultaneously suggesting substantial re-rating potential if AI power demand proves durable. Near-term, positive fundamental momentum is clear. Medium-term, as more hyperscaler PPAs (Microsoft, Google, AWS) are confirmed, Constellation's revenue visibility improves substantially. Key metrics: new PPA contract size and duration, nuclear plant capacity factor maintenance levels, US nuclear regulatory progress (SMR licensing, license extensions), and hyperscaler electricity demand expansion plans. In the context of long-term AI infrastructure power demand growth, Constellation is the highest medium-to-long-term upside candidate among non-tech names in this batch.

Watch：63.8% YoY growth is heavily dependent on AI data center power contracts; any slowdown in AI capex or PPA renegotiations would significantly compress growth rates.; Nuclear plant operations carry long-term structural risks including regulatory compliance, nuclear waste management, and maintenance cost escalation; safety incidents would trigger severe valuation impact.; Energy regulatory policy changes (electricity market design, subsidy policy) could affect PPA pricing power; US energy policy environment requires close monitoring.
beat_or_miss: 超預期 EPS 實際 $2.74 超越預估 $2.60，驚喜幅度 +5.3%，核電需求超預期帶動業績優化。
